comment: Resources reviewed and rejected. The weekly discovery run is told never to propose them again, and its candidates are filtered against these URLs. Inclusion rule: a resource is added only if the number of words it contributes can be counted exactly AND its texts are verifiably not already in the catalogue.

rejected.title: Digital Latin Library — Library of Digital Latin Texts (LDLT)
rejected.reason: Federates texts published elsewhere: the words it adds cannot be counted exactly, and they cannot be shown not to be in the catalogue already.
